_doc: #1777 the frozen BEFORE state of the two navigations this change reshapes (rule 16: a reorganisation drops nothing, and ships a parity test against the previous version). cad = Hardtech-CAD's ui at its last commit before the change (bottom nav MCAD | BIM | SolidWorks); simulation = the former simulation app's ui (bottom nav SAP2000 | MATLAB | Ansys) whose pages now live under Hardtech-CAD > Sim2Real. test-nav-parity.sh holds the new build.json to it.
